title: The Repentance of Believers
edition: Printed in the 1771 Works. The printing closes this sermon at Londonderry, on 24 April 1767.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1771 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. This sermon is in his 1771 Works. The printing closes it at Londonderry, on 24 April 1767. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1771 panel is the text of the Works Wesley himself had printed in 1771. It is public domain.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 14 in the 1771 Works. Mark 1:15. Dated at Londonderry, 24 April 1767.
